skills.description_zh: 「品牌风格丨社交配图设计师Skill」，内置 77 套品牌设计系统（Apple、Nike、Starbucks 等），选个名字就锁死整套图的配色、字体和氛围。支持 AI 生图+HTML 混合排版和纯 HTML 两种模式，把文案变成手机端可读的轮播配图。01【选个品牌名，整套图的风格就定了】把定稿文案、短视频脚本、报告摘要变成一组统一风格、手机端可读的社交媒体配图。内置 77 套从真实品牌设计系统萃取的风格档案，每套不是一句形容词，而是一组可直接注入的设计参数。02【它解决什么问题？】做配图最耗时的不是排版，是风格决策——找参考、调配色、选字体、做完 3 张发现和第 1 张对不上。用 AI 生图做配图，文字又全是乱码。想要"苹果那种感觉"，但说不清具体参数。这个 Skill 把风格变成了可执行变量：选个品牌名，配色、字体方向、圆角、卡片、氛围一次性锁死，从第一张图到最后一张图完全统一。03【77套品牌风格，选名字直接用】Apple、Nike、Airbnb、Starbucks、Stripe、Linear……75 个知名品牌 + 2 个原创风格。每套包含 6 个 CSS 色彩变量、情绪关键词、色调方向、字体方向、圆角规范——不是"像某品牌"，而是从品牌设计系统预萃取的完整参数包。输入内容后自动推荐 3-5 个匹配风格，你也可以直接指定。04【两种出图模式，自动适配环境混合模式】（AI 生图 + HTML 排版）：视觉冲击力交给 AI 生图，文字准确性交给 HTML。人物和物件经过 chroma-key 抠图，用光晕和阴影自然融入版式——不是矩形照片往上一贴。纯 HTML 模式：不需要任何 AI 生图能力，15 个组件 + 设计系统就能做出杂志级排版。05【从长文到配图，自动压缩拆页】给一篇长文或脚本，5 步压缩阶梯把它变成 4-8 页视觉大纲。中文标题按字数自动分档调字号（6 字以内用 88px，超 10 字缩到 56px），在语义断点手动换行，不让半个词掉到下一行。06【交付前自动质检】每张图逐项检查：标题够不够大、底部有没有空白、强调色是不是太多、人物有没有融入版式。4-band 密度检查确保竖图不出现大面积空洞。07【适合谁？】经常做社交媒体配图，受够了每次从零调风格的内容创作者；想让配图有品牌感但请不起设计师的个人 IP；做报告解读、知识卡片、方法论拆解，需要成套统一风格配图的知识博主；08【不适合谁？】只需要单张纯插画海报，或需要精确复刻复杂数据图表的场景；09【小提示】77 个风格只借鉴品牌的配色和设计氛围，不生成品牌 logo 或产品 UI；混合模式需要运行环境支持 AI 生图（如 Codex imagegen），纯 HTML 模式无此要求；渲染优先用 Playwright（2x 输出 2160×2880），无 Playwright 时降级为wkhtmltoimage 或浏览器截图；输出的 HTML 源文件可二次编辑，不锁定在工具内。
skills.name: 品牌风格丨社交配图设计师

skills.description: Alex Hormozi's $100M Offers — an executable toolkit for creating offers so compelling that people feel stupid saying no. Master the value equation, pricing psychology, and offer design to transform your business.  Covers 5 use cases: ① The Value Equation — understand the four levers that drive perceived value: Dream Outcome, Problem Awareness, Time Delay, Effort/Sacrifice ("Why aren't people buying my product" "How to make my offer irresistible" "What drives customer decisions") ② Pricing Strategy — escape the commodity trap, find a starving crowd, charge what your offer is worth ("How to price my product" "I keep competing on price" "How to find customers willing to pay premium") ③ Grand Slam Offer Design — create a transformative offer by stacking solutions, trimming the weak, and presenting it irresistibly ("How to create a winning offer" "What should I include in my package" "How to bundle my services") ④ Scarcity, Urgency & Bonuses — enhance any offer with psychological triggers that increase conversion without feeling manipulative ("How to create urgency ethically" "What bonuses to offer" "How to use scarcity") ⑤ Guarantees & Naming — remove risk with powerful guarantees and position your offer with names that sell ("Should I offer a guarantee" "How to name my offer" "How to reduce buyer risk")  Trigger when users say: "How to make more sales" "Create an offer" "Pricing strategy" "How to sell high ticket" "Value proposition" "Business offer" "Sales conversion" "Alex Hormozi" "Increase revenue" "Product bundling" "How to price my service" "Customer acquisition" "Sales psychology" "Offer design" or mention: Alex Hormozi / $100M Offers / grand slam offer / value equation / pricing / scarcity / urgency / bonuses / guarantee / starving crowd / offer design / high-ticket sales.  Related skills: winning (business strategy), the-essential-drucker (management), the-four-steps-to-the-epiphany (customer development), the-education-of-a-value-investor (value investing principles), one-up-on-wall-street (finding opportunities).

skills.description:
You launched an ambassador program. 3 applications. One ghosted after week 2. Should you lower the bar? Offer more perks? Spam influencers? This gives you the complete community & ambassador operations SOP — from pre-launch checklist to recruitment to tiered management to retention to governance. Built from Notion (20M users, real ambassador interviews), AFFiNE (60K stars), Asana, and ClickUp programs. By @WeiYipei.

What's inside:
• Pre-launch readiness checklist (6 conditions that must be true before starting)
• 6-step community setup SOP (platform selection → rules → admin standards → monitoring → wiki → metrics)
• Ambassador recruitment system (A+B qualification, application form design, scoring rubric)
• 4-tier progression system (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum with point thresholds)
• 5-pillar incentive framework (Product quality → Beta access → Founder access → KOL path → Full engagement)
• Churn early-warning system + retention playbook
• Event operations SOP (6 event types × full lifecycle)
• Health metrics dashboard (6 core KPIs + 5 ambassador-specific indicators)
• Governance & risk control (behavior code, escalation matrix)
• Real templates: recruitment post, welcome email, annual calendar

🇨🇳 你搞了个大使计划。来了3个申请。一个第二周就消失了。该降门槛？加福利？群发KOL？这份SOP给你从启动前置条件到招募到留存到治理的完整社区/大使运营方法论。基于 Notion（2000万用户，大使真实访谈）、AFFiNE（60K stars）、Asana、ClickUp 实战案例。

🇯🇵 アンバサダープログラムを立ち上げた。応募3件。1人は2週間で消えた。基準を下げる？特典を増やす？このSOPは、事前チェックリストから採用、段階管理、リテンション、ガバナンスまでの完全なコミュニティ＆アンバサダー運営フレームワークを提供します。Notion（2000万ユーザー）、AFFiNE（60K stars）の実例から構築。

🇰🇷 앰배서더 프로그램을 시작했습니다. 지원 3건. 하나는 2주 만에 사라졌습니다. 기준을 낮출까요? 이 SOP는 사전 체크리스트부터 모집, 단계별 관리, 리텐션, 거버넌스까지 완전한 커뮤니티 & 앰배서더 운영 프레임워크를 제공합니다. Notion(2000만 사용자), AFFiNE(60K stars) 실전 사례에서 구축.

Triggers: "ambassador program" | "community building" | "community management" | "DevRel" | "developer relations" | "community growth" | "大使计划" | "社区运营" | "社区搭建" | "コミュニティ運営" | "アンバサダー" | "커뮤니티 운영" | "앰배서더" | "open source community" | "user retention"
